source.entry: Markdown file or directory containing report.md/index.md

directiveSyntax.nestedContainer: Use a longer outer colon fence than nested directives.
directiveSyntax.numericColonText: Two- or three-part numeric time/duration tokens such as 21:01 and 1:30:05 remain literal Markdown text.

terms.description: Annotates exact first canonical glossary occurrences in one code fence.

manifestFields.name: contractVersion
manifestFields.description: Authored source-contract major; omitted legacy source is interpreted as version 1.

manifestFields.name: language
manifestFields.description: Language tag using the supported 2-8 letter primary and optional 2-8 character alphanumeric subtags.

manifestFields.name: preset
manifestFields.description: Coordinated package-owned visual defaults; explicit bounded token values override the preset.

manifestFields.name: layout
manifestFields.description: Responsive page composition selected from the package-owned layout catalog.

manifestFields.name: scrollProgress
manifestFields.description: Enables a decorative package-owned scroll indicator only in the normal-motion profile.

manifestFields.name: tokens
manifestFields.description: Compact package-owned visual token overrides; arbitrary CSS is not accepted.

fields.name: density
fields.description: Controls the shared spacing rhythm and control padding.

fields.name: accent
fields.description: Selects the accent and visible-focus color family.

fields.name: width
fields.description: Controls the maximum shell and reading width.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: Controls the shared corner treatment for surfaces and controls.

manifestFields.name: output
manifestFields.description: Default output settings; command-line flags can override the format.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Static artifact layout; single-file is the portable default.

fields.name: maxInlineBytes
fields.description: Warning threshold for bytes embedded into single-file output.

directives.name: section
directives.description: Labelled top-level page section containing Markdown.

attributes.name: reveal
attributes.description: Enables one package-owned one-time section reveal in the normal-motion profile.

directives.name: actions
directives.description: Responsive group containing ordinary action links.

directives.name: action
directives.description: Ordinary safe link inside an actions group.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Safe same-page, relative, HTTP(S), or email link target; executable and local-file schemes are rejected.

directives.name: source-link
directives.description: Source location opened through an explicit IPv4 loopback editor helper without replacing the report page.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Short visible source path and line.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: IPv4 loopback editor-helper URL with an absolute path and positive source line.

directives.name: callout
directives.description: Emphasized finding or notice containing Markdown.

directives.name: decision
directives.description: Static Markdown decision or typed decision containing decision-option directives.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Stable identity required when decision options are authored.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks this decision as required in the static document.

directives.name: decision-option
directives.description: One labelled option inside a typed decision.

directives.name: checklist
directives.description: Static structured checklist containing stable check-item directives.

directives.name: check-item
directives.description: One labelled required or optional checklist item.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks this item as required in the static document.

directives.name: cards
directives.description: Responsive grid, normally containing card directives.

directives.name: card
directives.description: One semantic card containing Markdown.

directives.name: steps
directives.description: Process or tutorial sequence containing Markdown, normally an ordered list.

directives.name: response
directives.description: Local structured reader-response workspace with deterministic export.

directives.name: question
directives.description: One typed question inside a response workspace.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Stable question identity within the response form.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Optional positive increment for number questions.

directives.name: bucket
directives.description: One named assignment bucket.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Stable bucket identity within the question.

directives.name: option
directives.description: One selectable answer option.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Stable option identity within the question.

directives.name: item
directives.description: One readable response item.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Stable item identity within the question.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Safe same-page, relative, HTTP(S), or email link target; executable and local-file schemes are rejected.

attributes.name: comment
attributes.description: Enables one optional comment for this item.

directives.name: copyable
directives.description: Ordinary Markdown prose with a localized copy control.

directives.name: glossary
directives.description: Reusable glossary definition containing Markdown.

attributes.name: term
attributes.description: Canonical glossary identity and explanation title.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Definition location in the authored flow or, for a top-level definition, one package-owned reference appendix.

directives.name: term
directives.description: Inline or standalone reference that opens a registered glossary explanation.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Key of the glossary definition to reference.

directives.name: disclosure
directives.description: Native disclosure with a visible summary.

directives.name: tabs
directives.description: Keyboard-operable group of tab panels.

directives.name: tab
directives.description: One labelled panel inside tabs.

directives.name: modal
directives.description: Modal dialog opened by a package-owned control.

directives.name: popover
directives.description: Non-modal contextual panel opened by a package-owned control.

directives.name: filter
directives.description: Client-side text filter for authored list items.

directives.name: toggle
directives.description: Switch controlling visibility of declarative content.

directives.name: chart
directives.description: Responsive bar, line, or pie chart rendered at compile time.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Meaningful plain-text description for the visual.

directives.name: series
directives.description: One named chart series containing data points.

directives.name: point
directives.description: One labelled numeric value in a chart series.

directives.name: diagram
directives.description: Directed flow diagram rendered as deterministic SVG.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Meaningful plain-text description for the visual.

directives.name: group
directives.description: One labelled subsystem group in a flow diagram.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique group identity within the diagram.

directives.name: node
directives.description: One labelled node in a flow diagram.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique node identity within the diagram.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Optional subsystem group identity for this node.

directives.name: edge
directives.description: One directed connection between diagram nodes.

directives.name: timeline
directives.description: Semantic chronological sequence with bounded events.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Meaningful plain-text description for the visual.

directives.name: event
directives.description: One dated timeline event with optional Markdown detail.

directives.name: demo
directives.description: Package-owned counter interaction; author code is never executed.

directives.name: asset
directives.description: Download link to a confined local file.

directives.name: font
directives.description: Register a confined local font; the first declaration becomes the document font.

attributes.name: family
attributes.description: CSS font family using letters, numbers, spaces, underscores, or hyphens.
